tiles.label: Peru & the Andes
tiles.visitorIntent: The Inca Trail as a trek: 26 miles / 4 days, the 500-per-day permit cap and lottery timing, altitude acclimatization before the trailhead, Sun Gate arrival, and the Salkantay/Lares fallbacks when permits are gone.

Seasons: "The best hiking conditions on the Inca Trail", "the Inca Trail lottery for the hiking route requires booking the previous November", "The Inca Trail closes entirely in February". Why-item "Altitude Management" (Lima -> Sacred Valley 9,000 ft two nights -> Cusco 11,000 ft). Place cards Machu Picchu, Sacred Valley, Cusco. Cost drivers: "Permits and an Amazon extension". Itinerary "Peru: Inca Trail & Lima": "Four days on the Inca Trail — the classic route, permits secured six months in advance… arrival at the Sun Gate at dawn"; intro "the two acclimatization nights in Cusco before the trek are non-negotiable"; why-item "Altitude Management" (Cusco 3,400 m).
Peru card facts: "Inca Trail Best: May – October", "Inca Trail Closure: February (maintenance)". No itinerary.
Single clause: "Machu Picchu at sunrise with a private guide" under early-entry permits. Culture intent, not trekking.
